Great bar (big plus if you are a Liverpool fans)
Sep 2022
Cheer Bar AKA Liverpool Bar

This bar is a little gem in the heart of the old quarter.
If you are a Liverpool fan, this bar will be 200% perfect for you! 
It will be the perfect place to have a beer and watch a Liverpool football match.

- Friendly staff and owneer. 
- Cheap prices. 
- Customer choice music.
- Liverpool live match on big TV

I'd highly recommend this place.

Great location, atmosphere, food, and drink
Mar 2022 • Solo
I’ve been to cheers bar many times and it’s always an enjoyable time. There is often a big crowd for any sporting event early or late making it a great place to watch games and meet people. They have a large selection of drinks at a good price along with a wide variety of Vietnamese and western foods you can eat at the bar. The location is also perfect because you are right in old quarter but also close to the main road making it an easy place to find. I recommend it to anyone visiting Hanoi.
